name: Adrian Trent
life: “I still remember a bunkmate singing the same line three days straight.” On Tuesday, near the market by Market Flats, Adrian often waits until the delivery baskets are stacked before going in.
voice: I remember a shipboard work song with the same interval. I came ashore to compare them.
appearance: Adrian has a wide brow and a narrow jaw. Look for silver temples and a dark fringe. Back on the street, the familiar outfit is a charcoal zip cardigan with a cloth patch so neatly matched it only shows in strong light. In conversation Adrian draws small circles on a tabletop while waiting.
personality: Likes beautiful, unnecessary things and gets cross with people who mistake poverty for a lack of taste. Adrian takes longer choosing a cheap birthday card than an expensive coat.
agenda: To compare the seafarer's work song with the recording.
family: Owen Brandt is Adrian’s younger cousin. Adrian asks the question the rest of the family avoided. Owen chooses an ordinary story to tell. They tend to get further with an important subject when it arrives in the middle of talk about dinner or work. Asked about *A sail cut small*, Owen says, “I cut a pattern from the wrong edge and ruined my plan.”
connections: Pearl Gross. A seafarer's tune becomes something the neighbor can feel through the counter.

reactions.situation: A tired neighbor asks the singers to move
reactions.response: Adrian asks when the neighbor sleeps and helps arrange a quieter hour.

reactions.situation: A family supper turns into an argument about old debt
reactions.response: Adrian asks each person to say what they believe is actually owed before anybody proposes a payment.

reactions.situation: When a relative dismisses a little luxury
reactions.response: Adrian asks which ordinary pleasure the relative would give up first.
